data.desc: EHang (Nasdaq: EH) is a global-leading Advanced Air Mobility technology platform company dedicated to making safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. EHang focuses on the research, development and manufacturing of a diversified portfolio of pilotless electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aerial vehicles, covering a wide range of application scenarios including aerial tourism, intra-city commuting, inter-city travel, logistics transportation and emergency firefighting.
